description: PLANNED (ADR-054, plan T21): Read a person's public inventory (GET /api/v1/people/:subject/items → inventory.inventory@1: owned instances of published definitions), their equipped set (GET /api/v1/people/:subject/equipped, GET /api/v1/equipped?subjects=… up to 100 → inventory.equipped-batch@1), definitions and kinds. It becomes active when OpenVibe.Inventory implements the route.
